title: TerraTrust
tagline: RWA Tokenization - ERC-3643 implementation for tokenized real estate with Pyth oracles
description:
A comprehensive real-world asset (RWA) tokenization platform implementing the ERC-3643 token standard, specifically designed for real estate tokenization. The platform bridges traditional real estate assets with blockchain technology through a secure, compliant, and user-friendly interface.

Core Features
Full ERC-3643 compliance with identity management and transfer restrictions
Pyth Network integration for real-time property valuations
Next.js 13 dashboard with TypeScript and TailwindCSS
Comprehensive compliance system for KYC/AML
Real-time valuation updates through oracle integration
Secondary market trading capabilities
how_its_made:
Contracts deployed with hardhat, wrote scripts to run them, used frontend to display the data in a presentable manner
I used a lot of documentation reading , github code examples to understand the working and implementations of the idea, self protocol compliance. Then at last combined everything together and built a running app
